title: Invariance under equivalent properties
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty domain, let $\beta$ be a finite alphabet, and let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester with finite seed space. Let $P,Q$ be properties of functions from $\Omega$ to $\beta$ that contain exactly the same functions, and let $\mathrm{rate}\in\mathbb R$. If $T$ is a local tester for $P$ at rate $\mathrm{rate}$—that is, $\mathrm{rate}>0$, every function in $P$ is accepted with probability $1$, and every function that is $\varepsilon$-far from every member of $P$ is rejected with probability greater than $\mathrm{rate}\,\varepsilon$ for each $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$—then $T$ is a local tester for $Q$ at the same rate.
